character.name: Fat Orange Tabby
character.description: A happy, jolly, chonky fat orange tabby cat, round and squishy body, short striped orange fur, big round cheeks, bright green eyes, and a big cheerful smile, hanging by one paw from a horizontal steel metal pole above its head, body dangling below, tail hanging down, other front paw tucked playfully against its round belly.

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
